from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(INSTALLED_APPS=[], DATABASES={})
django.setup()
from django.db.migrations import operations as mops
from django.db.migrations.optimizer import MigrationOptimizer
from django.db import models

class EmptyManager(models.Manager):
    pass

opt = MigrationOptimizer()
ops = [
    mops.CreateModel('Foo', fields=[('name', models.CharField(max_length=255))], managers=[('objects', models.Manager())]),
    mops.AlterModelManagers('Foo', managers=[('objects', EmptyManager())]),
]

res2 = opt.optimize(ops2, app_label='test_app')
print('cross-model:', [type(o).__name__ for o in res2])
assert len(res2) == 2, 'wrongly reduced across models'
print('OK')

from django.db.migrations import operations as mops
from django.db.migrations.optimizer import MigrationOptimizer
from django.db import models

class EmptyManager(models.Manager):
    pass

opt = MigrationOptimizer()
# 1) CreateModel + AlterModelManagers -> single CreateModel with new managers
res = opt.optimize([
    mops.CreateModel('Foo', fields=[('name', models.CharField(max_length=255))], managers=[('objects', models.Manager())]),
    mops.AlterModelManagers('Foo', managers=[('objects', EmptyManager())]),
], app_label='test_app')
assert len(res) == 1 and isinstance(res[0], mops.CreateModel), res
assert res[0].managers == [('objects', EmptyManager())], res[0].managers
print('reduce OK:', type(res[0]).__name__, res[0].managers)

# 2) different model names must NOT reduce
res2 = opt.optimize([mops.CreateModel('Foo', fields=[]), mops.AlterModelManagers('Bar', managers=[])], app_label='test_app')
assert len(res2) == 2, res2
print('cross-model untouched OK')

# 3) state_forwards equivalence: optimized single op == original two ops
from django.db.migrations.state import ProjectState
s1 = ProjectState(); s2 = ProjectState()
for op in [mops.CreateModel('Foo', fields=[], managers=[('objects', models.Manager())]), mops.AlterModelManagers('Foo', managers=[('objects', EmptyManager())])]:
    op.state_forwards('test_app', s1)
res[0].state_forwards('test_app', s2)
m1 = s1.models['test_app','foo']; m2 = s2.models['test_app','foo']
assert m1.managers == m2.managers, (m1.managers, m2.managers)
print('state equivalence OK')
"
